en: A colorful Christmas-themed illustration showing several cartoon Santas working in a wooden log cabin. One Santa sits at a desk using a computer, highlighted with a yellow glow. Another Santa stands on a ladder hammering or fixing something near the roof, while a third Santa outside the cabin is joyfully blowing into a musical instrument, producing musical notes. Piles of letters or packages lie around the cabin. On the upper right corner there is a blue and red triangular logo resembling a stylized postal or corporate emblem. The style is humorous and modern, and there is an artist's signature with the year '87 in the lower right.
